intro_en: Definitions apply to this map. A label describes source evidence, not a regulatory certificate, current ownership or new investment.
intro_id: Definisi ini berlaku untuk peta SLI. Label menjelaskan bukti dari sumber, bukan sertifikat regulasi, kepemilikan terkini, atau investasi baru.

sections.title_en: Start here: how to read the classification
sections.title_id: Mulai di sini: cara membaca klasifikasi

items.definition_en: Industrial facility processing crude petroleum into gasoline, diesel, jet fuel and other products; categorically different from upstream oil/gas WK and metal smelting.
items.definition_id: Pabrik pengolahan minyak mentah menjadi BBM seperti bensin, solar dan avtur; berbeda dari WK hulu migas dan smelter logam.

items.definition_en: Processing removes impurities or separates raw gas; an LNG train cools gas for shipment. Neither is an oil refinery nor the original upstream PSC.
items.definition_id: Fasilitas pengolahan gas memisahkan kotoran/komponen; train LNG mencairkan gas untuk diangkut. Keduanya bukan kilang minyak atau kontrak WK itu sendiri.

items.definition_en: A coal mine extracts fuel; a coal-fired PLTU burns that fuel to generate electricity. This map classifies the mine under Coal Mining and the PLTU under Power Generation.
items.definition_id: Tambang batubara menghasilkan bahan bakar; PLTU membakar bahan bakar tersebut untuk menghasilkan listrik. Di peta, tambang masuk Coal Mining dan PLTU masuk Power Generation.

items.definition_en: Metal smelters/refineries process mineral ore/intermediate products into metal; an oil refinery processes petroleum. 'Processing' is a process, not an additional stand-alone map sector.
items.definition_id: Smelter/pemurnian logam mengolah bijih/produk antara menjadi logam; kilang minyak mengolah minyak bumi. 'Processing' adalah kegiatan, bukan sektor baru terpisah.

items.term: Sector vs asset type vs source registry
items.definition_en: Sector: industry family. Asset type: a facility/contract/technology within it. Source registry: originating dataset, NOT an industry sector. Each row belongs to exactly one public-facing sector/type but can overlap another parent record.
items.definition_id: Sektor: kelompok industri. Jenis aset: fasilitas, kontrak atau teknologi dalam sektor tersebut. Registri sumber: asal dataset, BUKAN nama sektor. Setiap entri hanya satu sektor/jenis aset pada tampilan, namun dapat merujuk aset induk yang sama.

items.definition_en: Public phase is a simplified navigation label (reported operating, construction, planned, exploration, historical). Original text is shown separately and source dates control its reliability.
items.definition_id: Tahapan proyek di filter merupakan pengelompokan sederhana (operasi dilaporkan, konstruksi, rencana, eksplorasi, historis). Teks status asli ditampilkan tersendiri dan validitasnya bergantung tanggal sumber.

items.definition_en: Evidence describes an older project state but a current contract, operating permit, ownership or production status was not independently reconfirmed.
items.definition_id: Sumber menjelaskan kondisi terdahulu, tetapi kontrak, izin, operator atau status produksi terkini belum diverifikasi ulang.

items.definition_en: A mine extracts rock/ore; a smelter separates or transforms ore into a metal or intermediate. Same company may own both, but they are different types of assets.
items.definition_id: Tambang mengambil bijih/batuan; smelter mengolahnya menjadi logam/produk antara. Perusahaan yang sama bisa memiliki keduanya, tetapi jenis asetnya berbeda.

items.definition_en: Publicly announced investment, targeted spend or multi-year financial commitment is NOT BKPM/LKPM-reported investment realization and cannot be added to installed MW.
items.definition_id: Pengumuman nilai proyek atau komitmen belanja modal beberapa tahun BUKAN realisasi investasi yang dilaporkan ke BKPM/LKPM dan tak bisa dijumlahkan dengan MW terpasang.

items.definition_en: Acronyms denote power generating technology, not owner, investment status or number of plants. One complex can contain several generating units.
items.definition_id: Singkatan menyatakan teknologi pembangkit, bukan operator, status investasi atau jumlah lokasi. Satu kompleks bisa terdiri dari banyak unit.

items.definition_en: Locality pin shows an approximate city/district anchor backed by name evidence; an administrative province marker only means the province is known. Neither is surveyed GPS of a facility.
items.definition_id: Titik wilayah adalah perkiraan kota/kecamatan berdasarkan sumber; penanda provinsi hanya menunjukkan provinsi diketahui. Keduanya bukan koordinat GPS fasilitas hasil survei.

items.definition_en: FAME is biodiesel produced from fatty oils; a biodiesel/FAME factory is NOT a petroleum oil refinery or a metal smelter.
items.definition_id: FAME adalah bahan biodiesel dari minyak/lemak; pabrik FAME BUKAN kilang pengolahan minyak mentah dan BUKAN smelter logam.

items.definition_en: Working Area: a government-designated exploration/production contract area; one WK can contain several fields.
items.definition_id: Wilayah Kerja: area kontrak eksplorasi/produksi migas; satu WK dapat memiliki beberapa lapangan.

items.definition_en: Kontrak Kerja Sama / Production Sharing Contract: agreement governing upstream oil and gas activities; NOT a physical refinery.
items.definition_id: Kontrak Kerja Sama / Production Sharing Contract: kontrak pengelolaan kegiatan hulu migas; BUKAN kilang fisik.

items.definition_en: An oil or gas accumulation/development inside a WK; a field and its parent PSC can appear in separate source records.
items.definition_id: Akumulasi/lapangan migas dalam WK; lapangan dan KKS induknya dapat menjadi dua catatan sumber.

items.definition_en: At sea / on land. A province association for an offshore WK is NOT an oil platform GPS position.
items.definition_id: Lepas pantai / di darat. Asosiasi provinsi untuk WK offshore BUKAN titik GPS anjungan.

items.definition_en: Indonesian special task force for upstream oil and gas business activities.
items.definition_id: Satuan Kerja Khusus Pelaksana Kegiatan Usaha Hulu Minyak dan Gas Bumi.

items.definition_en: Aceh Oil and Gas Management Agency for upstream oil/gas activities in Aceh.
items.definition_id: Badan Pengelola Migas Aceh untuk kegiatan hulu migas di Aceh.

items.definition_en: Pertamina Hulu Energi, an Indonesian upstream oil and gas group.
items.definition_id: Pertamina Hulu Energi, grup usaha hulu migas Indonesia.

items.definition_en: Barrels per day: an oil-production flow rate, not reserves or installed processing capacity.
items.definition_id: Barel per hari: laju produksi minyak, bukan cadangan atau kapasitas kilang.

items.definition_en: Million standard cubic feet per day: natural-gas flow rate at standard conditions.
items.definition_id: Juta standar kaki kubik per hari: laju aliran gas pada kondisi baku.

items.definition_en: Trillion cubic feet of gas volume; a resource/reserves volume, not daily production.
items.definition_id: Triliun kaki kubik volume gas; ukuran sumber daya/cadangan, bukan produksi harian.

items.definition_en: Liquefied Natural Gas: gas cooled into liquid for transport; an LNG plant is NOT an oil refinery.
items.definition_id: Gas alam cair untuk penyimpanan/pengiriman; pabrik LNG BUKAN kilang minyak.

items.definition_en: Carbon Capture and Storage: capture and permanent subsurface storage of CO₂.
items.definition_id: Penangkapan dan penyimpanan permanen CO₂ di bawah permukaan.

items.definition_en: Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage: capture, utilisation and/or storage of CO₂; a project plan is not confirmed emissions reduction.
items.definition_id: Penangkapan, pemanfaatan, dan penyimpanan CO₂; rencana proyek bukan bukti pengurangan emisi yang sudah tercapai.

items.definition_en: Coal-fired (or other steam-cycle) power station / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Uap. Co-firing biomass does not automatically convert it to a renewable-only station.
items.definition_id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Uap; pada registri PLTU ini terutama berbahan bakar batubara. Co-firing biomassa tidak otomatis menjadikannya pembangkit EBT penuh.

items.definition_en: Gas-turbine power plant / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Gas.
items.definition_id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Gas, memakai turbin gas.

items.definition_en: Combined-cycle gas-and-steam power plant; distinct from coal PLTU.
items.definition_id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Gas dan Uap (siklus gabungan); berbeda dari PLTU batubara.

items.definition_en: Gas-engine power plant / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Mesin Gas.
items.definition_id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Mesin Gas.

items.definition_en: Diesel-engine power plant / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Diesel.
items.definition_id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Diesel.

items.definition_en: Hydropower / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Air; usually larger-scale hydroelectric plants.
items.definition_id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Air, biasanya skala pembangkit hidro besar.

items.definition_en: Mini-hydro / micro-hydro hydropower stations.
items.definition_id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Minihidro / Mikrohidro.

items.definition_en: Geothermal power plant / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Panas Bumi.
items.definition_id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Panas Bumi.

items.definition_en: Solar photovoltaic power / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Surya.
items.definition_id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Surya (fotovoltaik).

items.definition_en: Wind-powered electricity / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Bayu.
items.definition_id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Bayu atau angin.

items.definition_en: Nuclear power plant / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Nuklir; a proposal is not an operating reactor.
items.definition_id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Nuklir; usulan lokasi bukan reaktor beroperasi.

items.definition_en: Biomass / biogas electricity generation.
items.definition_id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Biomassa / Biogas.

items.definition_en: Energi Baru dan Terbarukan / New and Renewable Energy; do not assume all technology labels are fossil-free.
items.definition_id: Energi Baru dan Terbarukan; tidak semua label teknologi otomatis berarti tanpa emisi atau tanpa fosil.

items.definition_en: Electricity Supply Business Plan / Rencana Usaha Penyediaan Tenaga Listrik: PLN system planning, NOT proof each planned asset is financed or operating.
items.definition_id: Rencana Usaha Penyediaan Tenaga Listrik PLN: dokumen rencana sistem, BUKAN bukti seluruh proyek sudah didanai atau beroperasi.

items.definition_en: Indonesia's state electricity company / Perusahaan Listrik Negara.
items.definition_id: Perusahaan Listrik Negara, BUMN sektor ketenagalistrikan.

items.definition_en: Independent Power Producer: non-PLN plant developer/operator selling electricity under commercial terms.
items.definition_id: Independent Power Producer: pengembang/operator pembangkit non-PLN yang menjual listrik menurut perjanjian komersial.

items.definition_en: Power capacity produced primarily for the owner's industrial use; not automatically delivered to the public grid.
items.definition_id: Pembangkit untuk kebutuhan sendiri seperti smelter atau kawasan industri; tidak otomatis menyalurkan listrik ke jaringan umum.

items.definition_en: Power Purchase Agreement / Perjanjian Jual Beli Tenaga Listrik; a contract, not evidence of commissioned plant capacity.
items.definition_id: Power Purchase Agreement / Perjanjian Jual Beli Tenaga Listrik; perjanjian komersial, bukan bukti pembangkit sudah COD.

items.definition_en: Battery Energy Storage System: electricity storage, not electricity generation.
items.definition_id: Battery Energy Storage System: sistem penyimpanan listrik dengan baterai, bukan pembangkitan listrik.

items.definition_en: A site extracting coal or mineral ore; extraction is distinct from refining or smelting.
items.definition_id: Lokasi pengambilan batubara atau bijih mineral; berbeda dari fasilitas pengolahan/pemurnian.

items.definition_en: A metallurgical facility converting ores/concentrates into metal, alloy or intermediate products using thermal/electrochemical processing.
items.definition_id: Fasilitas metalurgi yang mengolah bijih/konsentrat menjadi logam, paduan atau produk antara melalui proses termal/elektrokimia.

items.definition_en: A mineral purification/refining plant; NOT petroleum refinery. Alumina refining is generally chemical processing rather than metal smelting.
items.definition_id: Fasilitas pemurnian mineral, BUKAN kilang minyak. Pemurnian alumina umumnya proses kimia, bukan peleburan logam.

items.definition_en: Plant upgrading ore into mineral concentrate before subsequent metallurgy; NOT necessarily a smelter.
items.definition_id: Fasilitas peningkatan kadar bijih menjadi konsentrat sebelum proses metalurgi; belum tentu smelter.

items.definition_en: High Pressure Acid Leach: hydrometallurgical process used for some nickel laterite ores.
items.definition_id: High Pressure Acid Leach: proses hidrometalurgi pelindian asam bertekanan untuk sebagian bijih nikel laterit.

items.definition_en: Rotary Kiln–Electric Furnace: pyrometallurgical route often used for nickel pig iron/ferronickel.
items.definition_id: Rotary Kiln–Electric Furnace: jalur pirometalurgi untuk menghasilkan antara lain NPI atau feronikel.

items.definition_en: Nickel Pig Iron / Ferronickel: nickel-bearing iron products, not battery-grade nickel sulfate.
items.definition_id: Nickel Pig Iron / Feronikel: produk besi bernikel, bukan langsung nikel sulfat kelas baterai.

items.definition_en: Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate: intermediate nickel/cobalt product from some hydrometallurgical routes.
items.definition_id: Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate: produk antara nikel/kobalt dari jalur hidrometalurgi.

items.definition_en: Crude Palm Oil / Palm Kernel Oil, input oils used by multiple downstream product chains.
items.definition_id: Crude Palm Oil / Palm Kernel Oil, minyak sawit mentah dan minyak inti sawit untuk berbagai proses hilir.

items.definition_en: Fatty Acid Methyl Esters: standard biodiesel blending component; biodiesel plant is NOT an oil refinery.
items.definition_id: Fatty Acid Methyl Esters: komponen biodiesel untuk campuran solar; pabrik biodiesel BUKAN kilang minyak bumi.

items.definition_en: Diesel-fuel blend notation with nominal biodiesel share of 35%, 40%, or 50%; mandate/targets are not plant output.
items.definition_id: Notasi campuran solar dengan target porsi biodiesel 35%, 40% atau 50%; mandat/target bukan bukti volume produksi fasilitas.

items.definition_en: Sustainable Aviation Fuel: a regulated aviation-fuel pathway, not identical to FAME diesel biodiesel.
items.definition_id: Sustainable Aviation Fuel: bahan bakar penerbangan berkelanjutan, tidak sama dengan biodiesel FAME untuk kendaraan diesel.

items.definition_en: Infrastructure designed for demanding AI workloads; does NOT independently verify GPUs or AI model-training operations.
items.definition_id: Infrastruktur yang dirancang mendukung beban AI; BUKAN bukti GPU atau pelatihan model AI sudah beroperasi.

items.definition_en: Facility housing IT infrastructure; colocation, cloud, AI and hyperscale describe different service arrangements, not equivalent projects.
items.definition_id: Fasilitas infrastruktur TI; colocation, cloud, AI, dan hyperscale merupakan model/karakteristik berbeda.

items.definition_en: Hyperscale Data Center: large modular/flexible capacity campus; published full build-out is not currently active IT load.
items.definition_id: Hyperscale Data Center: kampus kapasitas besar; kapasitas desain akhir tidak sama dengan IT load aktif.

items.definition_en: Graphics Processing Unit: compute accelerator sometimes used for AI; a facility MW figure cannot establish GPU counts.
items.definition_id: Graphics Processing Unit: akselerator komputasi untuk sejumlah beban AI; angka MW tidak membuktikan jumlah GPU.

items.definition_en: Availability Zone / regional cloud service geography; customer-facing 'Jakarta' cloud region does not reveal physical AZ addresses.
items.definition_id: Availability Zone / wilayah layanan cloud; nama region 'Jakarta' tidak menunjukkan alamat fisik AZ.

items.definition_en: Power consumed by IT equipment, different from total facility incoming power including cooling and auxiliaries.
items.definition_id: Daya yang dipakai perangkat TI; berbeda dari daya masuk fasilitas termasuk pendinginan dan sistem bantu.

items.definition_en: Power Usage Effectiveness: total data-center facility energy divided by IT equipment energy; closer to 1 indicates lower overhead.
items.definition_id: Power Usage Effectiveness: energi total fasilitas dibagi energi perangkat TI; makin mendekati 1 berarti overhead makin rendah.

items.definition_en: Memorandum of Understanding / nota kesepahaman; not automatically a binding financed construction agreement.
items.definition_id: Nota kesepahaman; tidak otomatis menjadi kontrak konstruksi dengan pembiayaan pasti.

items.definition_en: Front-End Engineering Design: detailed engineering preparation before final investment decisions.
items.definition_id: Front-End Engineering Design: rancangan rekayasa awal sebelum keputusan investasi final.

items.definition_en: Final Investment Decision: formal project go-ahead subject to stated conditions; not COD or actual spending.
items.definition_id: Final Investment Decision: keputusan akhir investasi sesuai syarat proyek; bukan berarti proyek sudah COD/selesai dibangun.

items.definition_en: Engineering, Procurement and Construction: design, procurement and physical construction contracting.
items.definition_id: Engineering, Procurement and Construction: kontrak rekayasa, pengadaan dan konstruksi.

items.definition_en: Commercial Operation Date: start of contracted commercial service after necessary tests; different from groundbreaking or commissioning tests.
items.definition_id: Commercial Operation Date: tanggal mulai operasi komersial setelah uji yang diperlukan; berbeda dari groundbreaking/pengujian commissioning.

items.definition_en: Testing and start-up phase before routine commercial service; completion is not assumed without evidence.
items.definition_id: Tahap pengujian/pengaktifan sebelum operasi komersial rutin; selesai tidak boleh diasumsikan tanpa bukti.

items.definition_en: Milestone ladder: expression of intent → power contract → final investment approval → commercially operating; steps are NOT interchangeable.
items.definition_id: Urutan tonggak: niat kerja sama → kontrak listrik → keputusan investasi → operasi komersial; statusnya TIDAK boleh disamakan.

items.definition_en: Kilowatt / megawatt / gigawatt = 1,000 W / 1 million W / 1 billion W; measures POWER, not energy generated.
items.definition_id: Kilowatt / megawatt / gigawatt = 1.000 W / 1 juta W / 1 miliar W; ukuran DAYA, bukan energi yang dihasilkan.

items.definition_en: Kilowatt-hour / megawatt-hour / gigawatt-hour: amounts of ENERGY delivered or consumed over time, not nameplate capacity.
items.definition_id: Kilowatt-jam / megawatt-jam / gigawatt-jam: jumlah ENERGI yang dihasilkan/dipakai dalam waktu tertentu.

items.definition_en: Megawatt-peak: solar PV DC rating under standard test conditions, not assured AC grid dispatch.
items.definition_id: Megawatt-peak: kapasitas puncak DC modul surya pada kondisi uji, bukan pasokan AC aktual jaringan.

items.definition_en: Megavolt-amperes: apparent electrical power, not necessarily MW without a power-factor assumption.
items.definition_id: Megavolt-ampere: daya semu listrik, tidak selalu setara MW tanpa faktor daya.

items.definition_en: Megawatts of IT-equipment load at a data center; cannot be directly added to power plant generation capacity.
items.definition_id: Megawatt beban perangkat TI pusat data; tidak boleh dijumlahkan dengan kapasitas pembangkit listrik.

items.definition_en: Kilolitres (1,000 litres) / megalitres (1,000,000 litres) of liquid volume; 'million kL' = 1 billion litres.
items.definition_id: Kiloliter (1.000 liter) / megaliter (1 juta liter) volume cairan; 'juta kL' = 1 miliar liter.

items.definition_en: Million tonnes (mass) / tonnes per day (throughput); neither is revenue or MW.
items.definition_id: Juta ton massa / ton per hari laju produksi/pengolahan; bukan nilai pendapatan atau MW.

items.definition_en: Indonesian rupiah / international IDR currency code / US dollars; never add money figures with incompatible currencies or bases.
items.definition_id: Rupiah / kode mata uang rupiah / dolar AS; jangan jumlahkan angka dengan mata uang dan dasar pelaporan berbeda.

items.definition_en: Foreign / domestic direct investment realization classifications under Indonesian investment statistics.
items.definition_id: Penanaman Modal Asing / Penanaman Modal Dalam Negeri pada statistik investasi Indonesia.

items.definition_en: Indonesian investment ministry/coordination board / company Investment Activity Reports; an announcement is NOT LKPM realized investment.
items.definition_id: Kementerian Investasi/BKPM / Laporan Kegiatan Penanaman Modal; pengumuman investasi BUKAN realisasi LKPM.

items.definition_en: Capital expenditure: money actually budgeted or spent to build long-lived assets; announcement, financing facility and realization differ.
items.definition_id: Belanja modal; komitmen, fasilitas pembiayaan, dan pengeluaran yang benar-benar terjadi adalah angka berbeda.

items.definition_en: Global latitude/longitude reference system; a district/city anchor is not a surveyed facility coordinate.
items.definition_id: Sistem referensi lintang/bujur global; titik kota/kabupaten bukan koordinat survei fasilitas.

items.definition_en: Geographic place-name reference used for approximate locality markers; not proof of project address.
items.definition_id: Basis data nama tempat untuk penanda wilayah perkiraan; bukan bukti alamat proyek.

items.definition_en: One province can contain many sites; one site can contain many generating units; an operator dossier can overlap both.
items.definition_id: Satu provinsi dapat memiliki banyak lokasi; satu kompleks bisa memiliki banyak unit; dossier operator dapat beririsan dengan keduanya.

categories_intro_en: These asset types sit BELOW the industry sector. They are facility/contract definitions, not independent source registries.
categories_intro_id: Jenis aset berada DI BAWAH sektor industri. Istilah berikut adalah definisi fasilitas/kontrak, bukan registri data yang berdiri sendiri.

categories.definition_en: Exploration / production contract area or oil/gas field; not a refining facility.
categories.definition_id: Wilayah kontrak atau lapangan produksi migas; bukan fasilitas pengilangan.

categories.definition_en: Petroleum refining plant converting crude oil into fuels and products; not mineral refining.
categories.definition_id: Kilang pengolahan minyak bumi menjadi BBM dan produk turunan; bukan pemurnian mineral.

categories.definition_en: Gas production, treatment, liquefaction and LNG infrastructure; not petroleum refinery.
categories.definition_id: Fasilitas produksi, pengolahan, pencairan gas dan LNG; bukan kilang minyak.

categories.definition_en: CO₂ capture/storage or use; carbon management is not proof of oil/gas production.
categories.definition_id: Proyek penangkapan, penyimpanan atau pemanfaatan CO₂; bukan bukti produksi migas.

categories.definition_en: Oil/gas-related entry lacking enough evidence for a more specific facility type.
categories.definition_id: Entri migas yang belum cukup jelas untuk ditetapkan sebagai fasilitas tertentu.

categories.definition_en: Coal pits, mines and dedicated logistics; different from coal-fired power generation.
categories.definition_id: Tambang, pit, dan logistik batubara; berbeda dari PLTU.

categories.definition_en: Ore mine, geology or mineral exploration; distinct from smelter/refinery.
categories.definition_id: Tambang, geologi, atau eksplorasi mineral; berbeda dari smelter/kilang mineral.

categories.definition_en: Metallurgical processing or purification of ores/metals. Includes smelting, nickel processing, and alumina refining; specific processes differ.
categories.definition_id: Pengolahan/pemurnian bijih atau logam: mencakup peleburan, pengolahan nikel, dan kilang alumina. Proses tiap fasilitas berbeda.

categories.definition_en: Broader mineral/battery processing chain, not yet verified as a smelter.
categories.definition_id: Rantai proyek mineral/bahan baterai yang belum tentu berupa smelter fisik.

categories.definition_en: Coal-fired steam power station or unit; plant and individual units can overlap.
categories.definition_id: Pembangkit listrik tenaga uap berbahan bakar batubara; lokasi dan unit bisa tercatat bersamaan.

categories.definition_en: Gas turbine, combined-cycle gas/steam or gas-based independent power plant.
categories.definition_id: Pembangkit turbin gas, siklus gabungan gas-uap atau IPP berbahan bakar gas.

categories.definition_en: Diesel-fuel power generation, typically diesel engine facilities.
categories.definition_id: Pembangkit listrik tenaga diesel berbasis mesin.

categories.definition_en: Hydroelectric power station; not the same as pumped-storage unit count.
categories.definition_id: Pembangkit listrik tenaga air; tidak sama dengan hitungan unit penyimpanan pompa.

categories.definition_en: Mini- and micro-hydro electricity facilities.
categories.definition_id: Pembangkit listrik minihidro dan mikrohidro.

categories.definition_en: Electricity generation using geothermal heat.
categories.definition_id: Pembangkit listrik yang menggunakan panas bumi.

categories.definition_en: Solar photovoltaic electricity; MWp peak differs from average MW output.
categories.definition_id: Pembangkit listrik tenaga surya; MWp puncak berbeda dari rata-rata keluaran MW.

categories.definition_en: Wind farm or wind turbine electricity project.
categories.definition_id: Pembangkit listrik tenaga bayu/angin.

categories.definition_en: Storage (battery/pumped hydro) not itself new net energy generation.
categories.definition_id: Penyimpanan energi (baterai/hidro pompa), bukan penciptaan energi neto baru.

categories.definition_en: Electricity development not classified more precisely from available source.
categories.definition_id: Proyek listrik yang jenisnya belum bisa dipastikan dari sumber tersedia.

categories.definition_en: FAME biofuel plant or registered supply point; do not infer current throughput from quota.
categories.definition_id: Pabrik biodiesel FAME atau titik pasokan; kuota bukan produksi aktual.

categories.definition_en: Upstream biomass/palm feedstock or other bioenergy, not a confirmed FAME facility.
categories.definition_id: Bahan baku biomassa/sawit atau bioenergi lain; belum pasti pabrik FAME.

categories.definition_en: Identified physical IT facility/campus; AI-ready is not verified GPU deployment.
categories.definition_id: Pusat data/kampus fisik yang lokasinya teridentifikasi; AI-ready bukan bukti GPU sudah terpasang.

categories.definition_en: Cloud service availability in a region; not a disclosed physical data-center address.
categories.definition_id: Wilayah layanan komputasi awan; bukan alamat fisik pusat data yang diumumkan.

categories.definition_en: Agreement, policy or investment programme related to AI, not necessarily built infrastructure.
categories.definition_id: Kesepakatan, kebijakan atau program investasi AI; belum tentu fasilitas sudah dibangun.

categories.definition_en: Electric vehicle manufacture or assembly; not automatically battery-cell factory.
categories.definition_id: Pabrik/perakitan kendaraan listrik; belum tentu pabrik sel baterai.

categories.definition_en: Battery, cathode/anode or material supply-chain assets.
categories.definition_id: Fasilitas sel baterai, katoda/anoda dan material terkait.

categories.definition_en: Nuclear technology evaluation or planned site; not an operating reactor.
categories.definition_id: Kajian teknologi/lokasi nuklir; belum menunjukkan reaktor beroperasi.

categories.definition_en: Project or policy crossing sectors or lacking verifiable primary asset type.
categories.definition_id: Proyek/kebijakan lintas sektor atau belum jelas jenis aset utamanya.

source_layers.definition_en: Announced, financed, constructed and operating projects from investment registries; a source layer, not a sector.
source_layers.definition_id: Catatan investasi diumumkan, didanai, dibangun atau beroperasi; ini sumber registri, bukan sektor.

source_layers.definition_en: Company-stated assets and activities, may refer to a parent company rather than unique site.
source_layers.definition_id: Daftar aset/kegiatan menurut perusahaan, bisa merupakan entri induk dan bukan situs unik.

source_layers.definition_en: Published name/capacity of oil refineries; does not include upstream oil fields.
source_layers.definition_id: Daftar kilang minyak menurut sumber; tidak mencakup lapangan migas hulu.

source_layers.definition_en: Sites, tenants and mine pits with location evidence; multiple dossiers may share a single estate.
source_layers.definition_id: Bukti lokasi tambang, pit, atau tenant; beberapa dossier bisa satu kawasan.

source_layers.definition_en: Historical PSC/field disclosures, with operator and licence needing current verification.
source_layers.definition_id: Daftar historis WK/lapangan migas; operator dan masa kontrak perlu verifikasi terbaru.

source_layers.definition_en: Named PLTU/PLTP/PLTA/etc sites, including historical rosters and company publications.
source_layers.definition_id: Daftar pembangkit PLTU/PLTP/PLTA/dll dari publikasi resmi/historis.

source_layers.definition_en: Published industrial location registers; may overlap site-level dossiers.
source_layers.definition_id: Direktori fasilitas biodiesel/smelter; dapat tumpang tindih dengan catatan fasilitas lain.

source_layers.definition_en: Targeted source-confirmed updates by province; not an independent set of unique investments.
source_layers.definition_id: Verifikasi khusus wilayah/provinsi; bukan himpunan investasi unik terpisah.

source_layers.definition_en: Source-identified physical data centers, separate from undisclosed cloud-region locations.
source_layers.definition_id: Fasilitas pusat data fisik yang teridentifikasi, terpisah dari cloud region tanpa alamat lokasi.

source_layers.definition_en: Additional power units and sites, possibly duplicate parent plants from older rosters.
source_layers.definition_id: Tambahan unit/lokasi PLTU; bisa sama dengan kompleks induk dalam daftar lama.
